newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends up on pre-holiday covering.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends up on pre-holiday covering.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices closed higher on pre-holiday covering and technical buying with July futures trading above the 1,280 ringgit. The April export data was within expectation and had no impact on the market. Friday's trend will depend on the performance of the Chicago soyoil today and Thursday.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Firmer, and interest was seen mainly among CPOs and RBD palm olein. The market reopens May 2.
Trading was fairly moderate and turnover was 1,940 lots.

Physicals May (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,365 vs bids of 1,362.50 after trading from 1,360 to 1,362.50. May (central) saw offers at 1,340 vs bids 1,335 with earlier trades done at 1,335 and 1,330.
June (south) was offered at 1,345 vs bids at 1,342.50 with earlier trades done at 1,335 and 1,342.50. June (central) saw offers at 1,320 versus bids at 1,315.
In refined products, last-half May RBD palm oil was offered at $572.50, June at $562.50 and July/Aug/Sept at $550.
Last-half May RBD palm olein saw offers at $607.50, June at $597.50, and July/Aug/Sept at $580. June was traded at $592.50, $595 and July at $585, $586 and $587.
May RBD palm stearin was offered at $435, June at $430 and May palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $290.
